kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتفرعن (form IIq)
# نَتَفَرْعَنُ (natafarʕanu) /na.ta.far.ʕa.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَرْعَنَ (tafarʕana)
# نَتَفَرْعَنَ (natafarʕana) /na.ta.far.ʕa.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَرْعَنَ (tafarʕana)
# نَتَفَرْعَنْ (natafarʕan) /na.ta.far.ʕan/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَرْعَنَ (tafarʕana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
